name: Ace in the Hole
description:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:
  • A Visceral or lower rarity add-on.
  • 100% chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.


When you escape, you keep your add-ons.

name: Adrenaline
description:
When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring Exhausted:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 4s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Aftercare
description:
You and up to 3 Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:
  • You unhook them, or they unhook you.
  • You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.


This effect lasts until you are hooked.

name: Agitation
description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • You gain 18% Haste.
  • Your Terror Radius is 12m larger.

name: Alert
description:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator:
  • You hear a sound cue.
  • You see their Aura for 5s.

name: Any Means Necessary
description:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use Activatable Button 1 for 3s to reset it.

You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.

name: Autodidact
description:
You start the trial with 0 Tokens, up to 5, and your good basic healing Skill Checks give 15% less progress.

While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn 1 token.
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain 15% more progress.
  • You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.

name: Babysitter
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They gain 10% Haste for 30s.
  • They leave no Pools of Blood for 30s.
  • They leave no Scratch Marks for 30s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for 8s.

name: Balanced Landing
description:
Whenever you fall from at least 1.25m:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 3s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.
  • Your stagger is 75% shorter.
  • Your Grunts from falling are 100% quieter.

name: Bamboozle
description:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for 16s.

You basic-vault Windows 15% faster.

Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.

name: Barbecue & Chili
description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 5s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least 40m away from the hooked Survivor.

name: Beast of Prey
description: Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain Undetectable for 40s.

name: Better Together
description:
While you are repairing a Generator:
  • Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura.
  • Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 30s.

name: Bitter Murmur
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within 16m of it for 5s.

When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 10s.

name: Blood Echo
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 30s, all injured Survivors:
  • Gain Exhausted.
  • Gain Hemorrhage.

name: Bloodhound
description: Pools of Blood are brighter and last 4s longer.

name: Blood Pact
description:
While you are not the Obsession:
  • While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras.
  • Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both gain 7% Haste.


When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

name: Blood Warden
description:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for 60s.

You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.

name: Boil Over
description:
While carried by the Killer:
  • Whenever the Killer falls from at least 1.25m, you gain 33% of your current wiggle progress.
  • Your wiggle is 80% stronger.
  • Within 16m, the Killer cannot see Hook Auras.

name: Bond
description: Within 36m, you see other Survivors' Auras.

name: Shattered Hope
description:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem:
  • You see the Auras of all Survivors within its range for 8s.
  • It is destroyed.

name: Borrowed Time
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They retain their unhook Endurance for 10s longer.
  • They retain their unhook Haste for 10s longer.

name: Botany Knowledge
description: You heal 50% faster.

name: Breakdown
description:
Whenever you are unhooked:
  • The Hook breaks, then is repaired after 180s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for 6s.

name: Breakout
description:
Within 5m of a carried Survivor:
  • You gain 10% Haste.
  • The carried Survivor wiggles 25% faster.

name: Brutal Strength
description: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 20% faster.

name: Buckle Up
description:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover:
  • The Survivor gains 50% Haste for 5s.
  • The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for 5s.

name: Built to Last
description:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for 10s, it is recharged to 99%.

Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges 33% fewer Charges.

name: Calm Spirit
description:
You do not scare Crows or scream.

You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, but 30% slower.

name: Camaraderie
description: While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within 16m, the timer is paused for 34s.

name: Corrupt Intervention
description: When the trial starts, the 3 farthest Generators from you are blocked for 120s, or until you down a Survivor.

name: Coulrophobia
description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius:
  • Heal 30% slower.
  • While healing, basic Skill Checks spin 50% faster.

name: Cruel Limits
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
  • You see the Auras of all Windows for 30s.
  • All Windows are blocked for Survivors for 30s.

name: Dance With Me
description: Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for 5s. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Dark Sense
description: Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within 24m of you, you see their Aura for 10s.

name: Dark Devotion
description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for 45s:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to 40m.
  • The Obsession has your Terror Radius.
  • You gain Undetectable.

name: Dead Hard
description:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use Activatable Button 1:
  • You gain Endurance for 0.5s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Dead Man’s Switch
description: When you hook a Survivor, the first time a Survivor stops repairing a Generator, it is blocked for 35s. Cooldown: 35s.

name: Deathbound
description:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, they scream. Then, until they take damage, while they are at least 4m away from that Survivor:
  • They gain Oblivious.
  • They see that Survivor's Aura.

name: Decisive Strike
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 60s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check:
  • Stun the Killer for 4s.
  • Become the Obsession.


This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

name: Deerstalker
description:
Every 30s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for 3s.

While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.

name: Deja Vu
description: You see the Auras of the 3 Generators closest to each other and repair them 6% faster.

name: Deliverance
description: Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain Broken for 120s.

name: Desperate Measures
description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor:
  • You heal 20% faster.
  • You unhook 20% faster.

name: Detective's Hunch
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for 20s, within 64m of you:
  • You see the Auras of Chests.
  • You see the Auras of Generators.
  • You see the Auras of Totems.

name: Discordance
description:
Within 128m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.

While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after 4s.

name: Distortion
description:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for 15s, you earn 1 Token, up to 2.

While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 12s:
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Distressing
description: Your Terror Radius is 30% larger.

name: Diversion
description:
After hiding for 20s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use Activatable Button 1 to throw a pebble 20m away:
  • The Killer is alerted.
  • The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.

name: Dragon’s Grip
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for the next 30s, the first Survivor that repairs that Generator:
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their position for 4s.
  • They gain Exposed for 60s.


Cooldown: 30s.

name: Dying Light
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn 1 token.

While the Obsession is alive, for each Token:
  • Other Survivors heal 3% slower.
  • Other Survivors repair 3% slower.
  • Other Survivors sabotage Hooks 3% slower.


The Obsession:
  • Heals other Survivors 33% faster.
  • Unhooks other Survivors 33% faster.

name: Empathy
description: Within 128m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.

name: Enduring
description: While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are 50% shorter.

name: Fire Up
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token:
  • You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls 6% faster.
  • You damage Generators 6% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors 6% faster.
  • You basic-vault Windows 6% faster.

name: Fixated
description:
While walking, you gain 20% Haste.

You see your own Scratch Marks.

name: Flip-Flop
description: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, 50% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to 50%.

name: Forced Penance
description: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain Broken for 80s.

name: For the People
description:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use Activatable Button 1 to heal them instantly:
  • You take damage.
  • You gain Broken for 60s.
  • You become the Obsession.


When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

name: Franklin's Demise
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they drop their item.

Within 64m, you see the Auras of dropped items.

name: Furtive Chase
description:
Whenever you hook the Obsession:
  • You gain 10% Haste for 18s.
  • You gain Undetectable for 18s.


Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.

name: Gearhead
description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next 30s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for 8s.

name: Overcharge
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Its regression speed will go from 85% to 130% over the next 30s.
  • The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose 4% more progress.

name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within 16m of Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.

name: Head On
description: After hiding in a Locker for 3s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for 3s if they are within 2.5m, then gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Hex: Devour Hope
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least 24m away, earn 1 Token, up to 5:
  • 2 Tokens | 10s after hooking a Survivor, gain 5% Haste for 10s.
  • 3 Tokens | Survivors gain Exposed.
  • 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.

name: Hex: Haunted Ground
description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.

When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
  • All Survivors gain Exposed for 60s.
  • The other Totem is extinguished.

name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn 1 Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.

While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.

Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose 6% more progress.

name: Hex: Ruin
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at 150% speed.

name: Hex: The Third Seal
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain Blindness.

This applies for up to 4 Survivors.

name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

For each Dull and Hex Totem remaining, you have 1 Token.

For each Token, Survivors bless and cleanse totems 10% slower.

name: Hex: Blood Favor
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor, Upright Pallets within 32m of them are blocked for 15s.

name: Hex: Retribution
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain Oblivious for 60s.

Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 20s.

name: Hex: Undying
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.

You see the Auras of Survivors within 4m of Dull Totems.

name: Hope
description: When all Generators are completed, you gain 5% Haste.

name: I'm All Ears
description: Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within 48m of you, you see their Aura for 8s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Infectious Fright
description: Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for 6s.

name: Inner Strength
description: Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not Broken, after hiding in a Locker for 8s, you become healthy instantly.

name: Insidious
description: After being idle for 1s, you gain Undetectable until you act.

name: Knock Out
description: Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next 6s, if they move 6m away from it, they gain 5% Hindered for 5s.

name: Iron Grasp
description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • They wiggle 12% slower.
  • Their wiggle is 75% weaker.

name: Iron Will
description: While injured and not Exhausted, your Grunts of Pain are 100% quieter.

name: Iron Maiden
description:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker:
  • They gain Exposed for 30s.
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their location for 4s.


You open Lockers 50% faster.

name: Hoarder
description:
When the trial starts, 2 more Chests appear.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an Item or starts unlocking a Chest within 64m of you, you are alerted.

name: Oppression
description: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to 4 other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: 35s.

name: Coup de Grâce
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 2 Tokens, up to 5.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend 1 Token to make it 80% longer.

name: Starstruck
description:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain Exposed. This ends 30s after:
  • They leave your Terror Radius.
  • You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.


Cooldown: 60s.

name: Hex: Crowd Control
description:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.

The last 6 Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.

You basic-vault blocked Windows 15% faster.

You see the Auras of blocked Windows within 24m.

name: No Way Out
description:
The first time you Hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token.

When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate:
  • It is blocked 12s, plus 12s for each Token.
  • You are alerted.

name: Lethal Pursuer
description:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 9s.

Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is 2s longer.

name: Hysteria
description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain Oblivious for 40s. Cooldown: 20s.

name: Eruption
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way:
  • Explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.
  • Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for 12s.


Cooldown: 30s.

name: Deadlock
description: Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for 25s.

name: Hex: Plaything
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

For 90s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.

The hexed Survivors:

  • Gain Oblivious.
  • Within 16m of the Hex totem, they see its Aura.

name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook:
  • They gain Hemorrhage for 90s.
  • They gain Mangled for 90s.
  • When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair 16% slower.

name: Grim Embrace
description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn 1 Token.

When you move 16m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for 10s.

When you have 4 Tokens, when you move 16m away from the hooked Survivor:
  • All Generators are blocked for 40s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for 10s.

name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
description:
When the trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • You earn 4 Tokens.


The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend 1 Token, then the Generator with the most progress:
  • Explodes, loses 20% progress and starts regressing.
  • Survivors repairing it scream.

name: Hex: Pentimento
description:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.

Within 16m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.

While a totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair 20% slower, plus 3% for each additional Rekindled Totem.

When all 5 Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.

name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for 7s.

name: Call of Brine
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses 50% faster for 90s.

For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.

name: Merciless Storm
description: The first time each Generator has 90% progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for 20s.

name: Dissolution
description: 3s after a Survivor takes damage, for 20s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.

name: Darkness Revealed
description: Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within 8m of Lockers for 8s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Septic Touch
description:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing:
  • They gain Blindness.
  • They gain Exhausted.


When they stop healing, this ends after 30s.

name: Superior Anatomy
description: Whenever a Survivor fast-vaults within 12m of you, the next time you basic-vault a window, it is 40% faster. Cooldown: 25s.

name: Awakened Awareness
description: While carrying a Survivor, within 20m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.

name: Terminus
description:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain Broken.

When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after 45s.

name: Nowhere to Hide
description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for 5s, you see the Auras of Survivors within 18m of you.

name: Hex: Face the Darkness
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every 25s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for 2s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.

name: Hubris
description: Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain Exposed for 30s. Cooldown: 20s.

name: Game Afoot
description:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain 7% Haste for 10s.

Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.

name: THWACK!
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 3 Tokens, up to 3.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend 1 Token. Then, all Survivors within 36m scream and you see their Auras for 6s.

name: Leverage
description: Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal 30% slower for 60s.

name: Genetic Limits
description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain Exhausted for 8s.

name: Forced Hesitation
description: Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within 16m of the downed Survivor gain 20% Hindered for 10s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Ultimate Weapon
description:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within 40m:
  • Gain Blindness for 30s.
  • Scream.


Cooldown: 45s.

name: Rapid Brutality
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain 5% Haste for 10s.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.

name: Alien Instinct
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor:
  • Gains Oblivious for 60s.
  • You see their Aura for 8s.

name: Hex: Two Can Play
description:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor 2 times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for 1.5s.

name: Friends ‘Til the End
description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession:
  • The Obsession gains Exposed for 20s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for 10s.


Whenever you Hook the Obsession, another Survivor:
  • Screams, then you are alerted.
  • Becomes the Obsession.

name: Batteries Included
description: Within 16m of a completed Generator, you gain 5% Haste. When you leave the range, this ends after 5s.

name: Unbound
description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next 30s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain 7% Haste for 10s.

name: Unforeseen
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for 30s and its radius is 32m.
  • You gain Undetectable for that time.


Cooldown: 30s.

name: Undone
description:
Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, earn 3 Tokens, up to 30.

Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent:
  • The Generator loses 1% progress.
  • The Generator is blocked for 1s.


When that Generator is unblocked, it begins regressing. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Weave Attunement
description:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped.

While a Survivor is within 12m of a dropped item:
  • You see their Aura.
  • They see the item's Aura.


Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain Oblivious for 30s.

name: Languid Touch
description: Whenever a Survivor within 36m of you scares a Crow, they gain Exhausted for 10s. Cooldown: 5s.

name: Dark Arrogance
description:
You basic-vault Windows 25% faster.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is 15% longer.

name: Hex: Wretched Fate
description:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Obsession:
  • Repairs 33% slower.
  • Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within 12m.

name: Human Greed
description:
Whenever a Survivor gets within 8m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for 5s.

You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: 10s.

You see the Auras of locked Chests.

name: Dominance
description: The first time each Chest is being unlocked and each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, it is blocked for 16s.

name: All-Shaking Thunder
description: Whenever you fall from at least 1.25m, your lunge-attacks are 75% longer for 25s. Cooldown: 5s.

name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.

Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for 10s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.

name: No Quarter
description: While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has 75% progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain Broken for 30s.

name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
description:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack 8 times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they gain 5% Hindered for 15s.

name: Forever Entwined
description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 8.

For each Token:
  • You hook Survivors 4% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors 4% faster.

name: None Are Free
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn 1 Token.

When all Generators are completed, for each Token:
  • Upright Pallets are blocked for 16s.
  • Windows are blocked for 16s.

name: Help Wanted
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When that Generator is completed by Survivors, your basic-attack cooldowns are 25% shorter for 60s.

Only 1 Generator can be compromised at a time.

name: Phantom Fear
description: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for 2s. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Haywire
description:
Exit Gate Switches with at least 80% progress regress at 100% speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.

name: Ravenous
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token.

When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors:
  • Scream.
  • Gain Exposed for 60s.

name: Wandering Eye
description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next 5s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20m. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Hex: Overture of Doom
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.

After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for 5 seconds:
  • You gain Undetectable for 30s.
  • For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.


When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.

name: Turn Back The Clock
description: After hooking a Survivor, for the next 60s, use Activatable Button 1 to make target Generator you can see within 20m explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.

name: Secret Project
description:
Whenever a totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for 30s.

Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain Undetectable for 30s.

name: Hex: Hive Mind
description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Auras of Generators show their progress.

When 1 Generator remains:
  • All Generators explode, lose 10% progress and start regressing.
  • The Hex Totem is extinguished.

name: Hex: Scared to Death
description:
After you hook 3 different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.

While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within 13m:
  • Scream.
  • Gain 13% Hindered for 3s.

name: Silent Shadow
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain Undetectable for 13s.

When all Generators are completed, you gain Undetectable.

name: Rampage
description:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn 1 Token, up to 13.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next 13s you gain 1% Haste for each Token. Cooldown: 20.

name: Celestial Witness
description: Every 30s, if the Obsession is at least 40m away from you, you see their Aura for 3s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
description:
The first time a Survivor gains a Hook State, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a running Survivor gains Haste within 32m of you, you are alerted.

Running Survivors cannot gain more than 15% Haste at a time.

name: Lay Waste
description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses 2% faster. Cooldown: 45s.

name: Kindred
description:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within 16m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.

While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within 16m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.

name: Leader
description:
Within 10m of you, other Survivors:
  • Cleanse Totems 30% faster.
  • Heal 30% faster.
  • Open Exit Gates 30% faster.
  • Sabotage Hooks 30% faster.
  • Unhook Survivors 30% faster.
  • Unlock Chests 30% faster.


After they leave your range, this ends after 20s.

name: Left Behind
description: When all other Survivors are dead, while within 32m of the Hatch, you see its Aura.

name: Lightborn
description:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for 10s.

You cannot be blinded.

name: Lightweight
description: Your Scratch Marks disappear 5s faster and appear more spread out.

name: Lithe
description:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 3s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Lucky Break
description:
While injured, for up to 60s:
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.


For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by 1s.

name: Mad Grit
description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is 100% shorter.
  • Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for 4s.

name: Make your Choice
description:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves while you are at least 32m away:
  • They scream.
  • They gain Exposed for 60s.


Cooldown: 60s.

name: Mindbreaker
description:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator:
  • They gain Blindness.
  • They gain Exhausted.


When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after 5s.

name: Monitor & Abuse
description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 15% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 25% smaller.

name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
description:
When the trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.


While you are at least 24m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, they are sacrificed 20% faster.

name: Nemesis
description:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession.

Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession:
  • They gain Oblivious for 60s.
  • You see their Aura for 8s.

name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
description:
When all Generators are completed, a Dull Totem ignites:
  • Survivors gain Exposed.
  • You gain 4% Haste.


Within 4m, Survivors see the Hex Totem's Aura, expanding to 24m over 30s.

name: No One Left Behind
description:
When all Generators are completed:
  • You heal 100% faster.
  • You unhook other Survivors 100% faster.
  • Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain 10% more Haste.
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.

name: No Mither
description:
When the trial starts, you become injured, then:
  • You gain Broken.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are 100% quieter.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You recover 25% faster.
  • You can fully recover.

name: A Nurse's Calling
description: Within 32m of Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras.

name: Object of Obsession
description:
While you are the Obsession, every 30s, the Killer sees your Aura for 3s.

While the Killer sees your Aura:
  • You see their Aura.
  • You cleanse totems 6% faster.
  • You heal 6% faster.
  • You repair 6% faster.


When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

name: Off the Record
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 40s:
  • You gain Endurance.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are 100% quieter.
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.

name: Open-Handed
description: All Survivors see Auras that have a range from 16m farther.

name: Overwhelming Presence
description:
Whenever a Survivor uses an item within 32m of you, they gain Exhausted for 15s.

Whenever a Survivor within 32m of you gains Exhausted, you see the closest Exhausted Survivor's Aura for 4s. Cooldown: 25s.

name: Pharmacy
description:
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.

You unlock Chests 125% faster.

The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is 12m shorter.

name: Play With Your Food
description:
Whenever you stop chasing the Obsession, you earn 1 Token, up to 3. Cooldown: 10s.


For each Token, gain 5% Haste.


Whenever you attack, lose 1 Token.

name: Plunderer's Instinct
description:
Within 64m of locked Chests and dropped items, you see their Auras.


Whenever you unlock a Chest, you are 50% more likely to find an item of higher rarity.

name: Poised
description:
The first time you start repairing each Generator, you see the Killer's Aura for 8s.


Whenever a Generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for 30s.

name: Pop Goes the Weasel
description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for the next 45s, when you damage a Generator, it explodes and loses 15% more progress.

name: Predator
description: When you stop chasing a Survivor, you see their Aura for 4s. Cooldown: 40s.

name: Premonition
description: While the Killer is within 36m of you and inside a 45 degree cone, whenever you look at them, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Prove Thyself
description: For each other Survivor within 4m of you, all Survivors repair 10% faster.

name: Quick & Quiet
description: You hide in Lockers and vault silently. The Killer is not alerted. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Red Herring
description:
After you repair a Generator for at least 1s, you see its Aura.

When you hide in a Locker, the Killer is alerted to the Generator. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Remember Me
description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 5.


For each Token, Survivors who are not the Obsession open Exit Gates 30% slower.

name: Repressed Alliance
description: After repairing Generators for 45s, while repairing a Generator alone, use Activatable Button 1 to block that generator for 15s.

name: Resilience
description:
While injured:
  • You bless and cleanse Totems 9% faster.
  • You heal 9% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates 9% faster.
  • You repair 9% faster.
  • You sabotage Hooks 9% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors 9% faster.
  • You unlock chests 9% faster.
  • You vault 9% faster.

name: Appraisal
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 4 Tokens.

Spend 1 Token to rummage an empty Chest, up to 2 times per Chest.

You rummage Chests 80% faster.

name: Deception
description:
Whenever you attempt to fast-enter a Locker:
  • You do not enter the Locker.
  • The Killer is alerted.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood for 5s.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks for 5s.


Cooldown: 15s.

name: Power Struggle
description:
While carried by the Killer, while you have at least 15% wiggle and next to an Upright Pallet, you can drop it to stun the Killer.

While downed, you see the Auras of Upright Pallets.

name: Fast Track
description:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn 1 Token, up to 3.

While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 5% permanent progress.

name: Smash Hit
description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 4s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 20s.

name: Self-Preservation
description: Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain Elusive for 30s.

name: Counterforce
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you cleanse a Totem, earn 1 Token, then, you see the Aura of the farthest Totem for 14s.

For each Token, you cleanse Totems 25% faster.

name: Resurgence
description: Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 70% healing progress.

name: Blast Mine
description:
After repairing 40% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use Activatable Button 2 to trap it for 120s. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

When the Killer damages that Generator, the trap explodes, then:
  • They are stunned for 4s.
  • Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.

name: Bite the Bullet
description:
While healing, you and the healed Survivor make no noises or Grunts of Pain. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check:
  • You lose only 1% progress.
  • The Killer is not alerted.

name: Flashbang
description:
After repairing 40% of Generators, while hiding in a Locker, use Activatable Button 1 to craft a Flashbang.

When you use the Flashbang:
  • Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
  • The Killer is alerted.

name: Rookie Spirit
description: After you hit 3 basic repair Skill Checks, while a Generator is regressing, you see its Aura.

name: Clairvoyance
description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, while not holding an item, use Use Item to, for up to 12s and within 64m:
  • See the Auras of Chests.
  • See the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
  • See the Auras of Generators.
  • See the Aura of the Hatch.
  • See the Auras of Hooks.

name: Boon: Circle of Healing
description:
While next to a totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • While healing without a Med-Kit, they heal others 100% faster.
  • While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.

name: Boon: Shadow Step
description:
While next to a Totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • Leave no Scratch Marks.
  • Their Auras cannot be seen by the Killer.


When leaving the range, this ends after 4s.

name: Overcome
description:
Whenever you take damage:
  • You retain your speed boost for 2s longer.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Corrective Action
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 3 Tokens, up to 5.

Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn 1 Token.

Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend 1 Token:
  • The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check.
  • You see that Survivor's Aura for 6s.

name: Boon: Exponential
description:
While next to a totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.

Downed Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • Recover 100% faster.
  • Can fully recover.

name: Parental Guidance
description:
Whenever you stun the Killer, for 7s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Empathic Connection
description:
You heal other Survivors 35% faster.

Injured Survivors see your Aura.

name: Boon: Dark Theory
description:
While next to a totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range gain 3% Haste. When leaving the range, this ends after 4s.

name: Inner Focus
description:
Whenever the Killer damages another Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura for 10s.

You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks.

name: Residual Manifest
description:
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain Blindness for 30s.

You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Flashlight.

name: Overzealous
description: Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, until you take damage, you repair 10% faster. If that Totem was a Hex Totem, the effect is doubled.

name: Wiretap
description:
After repairing 40% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use Activatable Button 2 to trap it for 120s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

While the Killer is within 14m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.

name: Reactive Healing
description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within 32m of you takes damage, you gain 50% missing healing progress.

name: Low Profile
description:
When all other Survivors are downed or hooked, for 90s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Better Than New
description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:
  • They bless and cleanse 16% faster.
  • They heal 16% faster.
  • They unlock Chests 16% faster.

name: Reassurance
description: Once per Hook State, while within 6m of a hooked Survivor, use Activatable Button 2 to stop the sacrifice progress for 30s.

name: Hyperfocus
description:
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.

For each Token, basic Skill Checks:
  • Appear 4% more often.
  • Spin 4% faster.
  • Whenever you hit a great, give 30% more progress.


Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, hit a good Skill Check, or stop healing or repairing, lose all Tokens.

name: Potential Energy
description:
While repairing, use Activatable Button 2 to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to 20 Tokens.

While you have at least 1 Token, Activatable Button 2 to spend all Tokens and gain 1% progress for each Token spent.

Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.

name: Fogwise
description: While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you see the Killer's Aura for 6s.

name: Quick Gambit
description:
While chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
  • Other Survivors repair 5% faster.


Whenever you take damage, cooldown: 40s.

name: Cut Loose
description:
While chased by the Killer, whenever you medium or fast-vault:
  • For up to 6s, your medium and fast vaults are silent.
  • During that time, whenever you medium or fast-vault, the timer is reset.


Cooldown: 45s.

name: Friendly Competition
description: Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair 5% faster for 120s.

name: Teamwork: Power of Two
description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within 16m of each other, you both gain 5% Haste. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.

name: Background Player
description:
Whenever the Killer picks-up another Survivor, for the next 10s, when you start running:
  • Gain 50% Haste for 5s.
  • Gain Exhausted for 20s.

name: Blood Rush
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 60s, while Exhausted, use Activatable Button 1 to lose Exhausted instantly.

This is disabled by conspicuous actions.

name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
description: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within 16m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4s.

name: Troubleshooter
description:
While chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
  • Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for 6s.


When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after 10s.

name: Made for This
description:
While injured, whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you gain Endurance for 10s.

While you have Deep Wound, you gain 3% Haste.

name: Scavenger
description:
While repairing and while your Toolbox is empty, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.

When you have 5 Tokens, spend them all:
  • Your Toolbox is recharged instantly.
  • You repair 50% slower for 30s.


You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.

name: Dramaturgy
description:
While healthy and running, use Activatable Button 1:
  • You gain 25% Haste for 2s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.


Then, one happens at random:
  • You gain 25% Haste for 2s.
  • You gain Exposed for 12s.
  • You gain a random rare item with random add-ons.
  • You scream, but nothing happens.


The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.

name: Scene Partner
description:
While you are within the Killer's Terror Radius, whenever you look at them:
  • Scream, then see the Killer's Aura for 6s.
  • There is a 50% chance you will scream again. If you do, you see the Killer's Aura for 2s more.


Cooldown: 40s.

name: Plot Twist
description:
While injured, crouched and idle, use Activatable Button 2 to be downed silently.

While downed this way, once per trial:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You recover 25% faster.
  • You can fully recover.


Whenever you recover this way:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 4s.
  • You are healed instantly.


When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability once again.

name: Lucky Star
description:
While hiding in a Locker, you make no Grunts of Pain.

Whenever you exit a Locker, for 30s:
  • You see the Aura of the closest Generator.
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.


Cooldown: 25s.

name: Chemical Trap
description:
After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Dropped Pallet, use Activatable Button 2 to trap it for 60s. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.

When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain 50% Hindered for 4s.

name: Light-footed
description:
While healthy and running, your footsteps are silent to the Killer.

Whenever you do a fast-action, cooldown: 10s.

name: Champion of Light
description:
While you are using a Flashlight, you gain 50% Haste.

Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain 20% Hindered for 6s. Cooldown: 40s.

name: Boon: Illumination
description:
While next to a totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • See the Auras of Chests.
  • See the Auras of Generators.


While you have a Boon Totem, you bless and cleanse 10% faster.

name: Deadline
description:
While injured, basic Skill Checks:
  • Are 10% more likely to appear.
  • Appear in random places.


Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 50% less progress.

name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use Activatable Button 1 to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
  • All Generators gain 10 permanent charges.
  • You become injured.
  • You gain Broken.


Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.

name: Strength in Shadows
description:
While in the Basement:
  • You can heal yourself, but 30% slower.
  • Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for 10s.

name: Wicked
description:
While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself.

Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for 20s.

name: Mirrored Illusion
description: After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Chest, Exit Gate Switch, Generator, or Totem, use Activatable Button 2 to create a static illusion for 60s.

name: Bardic Inspiration
description:
While idle, use Activatable Button 1 to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16m for up to 15s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20:
  • 1 | You scream, but nothing happens.
  • 2-10 | Basic Skill Checks give +1% progress.
  • 11-19 | Basic Skill Checks give +2% progress.
  • 20 | Basic Skill Checks give +3% progress.


If you complete the performance, this effect ends after 90s. Cooldown: 90s.

name: Still Sight
description:
After being idle for 2s, within 24m, until you start moving:
  • You see the Killer's Aura.
  • You see the Auras of Chests.
  • You see the Auras of Generators.

name: Finesse
description:
While healthy, you fast-vault 20% faster.

Whenever you fast-vault, cooldown: 30s.

name: Hardened
description: When you have blessed or cleansed a Totem and unlocked a Chest, whenever you would scream, you see the Killer's Aura for 5s instead.

name: Specialist
description:
Whenever you rummage or unlock a Chest, you earn 1 Token, up to 6.

While repairing a Generator, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 4% permanent progress.

name: Eyes of Belmont
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Killer's Aura for 3s.

Whenever you see the Killer's Aura for a duration, it is 2s longer.

name: Exultation
description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
  • Your item rarity is upgraded to the next tier, if possible.
  • If the item was upgraded, it recharges 75% Charges.


Cooldown: 20s.

name: Moment of Glory
description:
After you rummage or unlock 1 Chest, while not Broken, when you become injured, gain Broken.

After 60s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.

name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use Activatable Button 2 to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
  • Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 2s.
  • You become injured.
  • You gain Broken.


Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.

name: Clean Break
description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use Activatable Button 1 to gain Broken.

After 45s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.

name: Shoulder the Burden
description:
Once per trial, while you do not have 2 Hook States and are next to a hooked Survivor, use Activatable Button 2 to unhook them:
  • They lose 1 Hook State.
  • You gain 1 Hook State.
  • You scream.
  • You gain Exposed for 40s.

name: Do No Harm
description:
While healing another Survivor:
  • For each Hook State they have, you heal 50% faster.
  • Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you gain 3% more progress.

name: Duty of Care
description: While healthy, whenever you take a protection hit, other Survivors within 12m gain 25% Haste for 6s.

name: Rapid Response
description:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, you gain Exhausted for 20s.

Whenever you gain Exhausted, you see the Killer's Aura for 2s.

name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
description:
After you rummage or unlock 1 Chest, while next to a Broken Pallet, use Activatable Button 1 for 3s to create a Fragile Pallet.

Within 32m, you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.

name: Come and Get Me!
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use Activatable Button 1 to have injured and downed Survivors within 24m:
  • Make no Grunts of Pain for 15s.
  • Leave no Pools of Blood for 15s.
  • Leave no Scratch Marks for 15s.


You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for 5s.

name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
description:
While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for 30s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Conviction
description:
After you finish healing 1 other Survivor, while downed with at least 25% recovery, use Activatable Button 1 to recover instantly.

You gain Broken, then, after 30s, you are downed instantly.

name: Last Stand
description: After hiding for 90s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for 3s if they are within 2.5m.

name: Teamwork: Throw Down
description:
Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for 10s, other injured Survivors within 24m:
  • Gain Endurance.
  • See the Killer's Aura.

name: Road Life
description:
While injured, not Broken and repairing a Generator:
  • Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 1 token.


When you have 4 Tokens, spend all Tokens to heal 100% faster until you stop healing.

name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
description:
While idle, use Activatable Button 2 to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16m for up to 15s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are 20% more likely to appear.

If you complete the performance, the effect ends after 90s. Cooldown: 90s.

name: Ghost Notes
description:
While you have Exhausted, your Scratch Marks disappear 50% faster.

You lose Exhausted 10% faster.

name: Bada Bada Boom
description:
After repairing 20% of Generators, while next to a Window, use Activatable Button 2 to trap it for 60s. All Survivors see that Window's Aura for that time.

When the Killer vaults that Window, the trap explodes and they gain 50% Hindered for 6s.

name: Change of Plan
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 2 Tokens.

While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use Activatable Button 2 and spend 1 Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with 100% Charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.

name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are 25% bigger.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

name: Extrasensory Perception
description:
After crouching for 4s:
  • You see Auras in an expanding radius up to 44m.
  • You gain Elusive.
  • You gain Oblivious.


When you stop crouching, or after 11s, cooldown: 40s.

name: We See You
description:
Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn 1 Token. Cooldown: 10s.

When you have 4 Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 15s.

name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is 25% smaller.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5% faster.

name: Flow State
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token:
  • You bless and cleanse 10% faster.
  • You heal 10% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors 10% faster.

name: A Place For Us
description:
While healing another Survivor, you both gain Elusive.

Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, you both gain Elusive for 30s.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

name: Five Moves Ahead
description:
While you are in the Killer's Terror Radius or chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets and Windows.
  • After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.
  • Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 30s.

name: Wide Open Throttle
description:
Whenever you fast-vault a Pallet:
  • You gain 15% Haste for 3s.
  • The Pallet is reset, blocked for 60s, and all Survivors see its Aura for that time.


Cooldown: 60s.

name: Lend a Hand
description: Whenever you bless or cleanse 1 Totem, while healing another Survivor and only once per Survivor, use Activatable Button 2 to give them 4 permanent healing charges.

name: Cross-Examination
description: While in the Killer's Terror Radius and not being chased by the Killer, they leave Light Marks that last for 10s that you can see. While on the Killer's Light Marks, you gain Elusive. This ends after 5s.

name: Fruits of Your Labor
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token.

Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token:
  • You gain 5% Haste for 2s.
  • You gain 20% healing progress.

name: Salvation's Cry
description:
Whenever the Killer starts chasing you:
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors for 3s.
  • Survivors not being chased see your Aura for 5s.
  • Survivors not being chased see the Killer's Aura for 5s.

name: Boon: Steadfast
description:
While next to a Totem, use Activatable Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Generators within the Boon's range:
  • Regress 50% slower.
  • Survivors repair them 10% faster.


Survivors within the Boon's range see the Auras of affected Generators.

name: Saboteur
description:
Within 56m of where another Survivor was picked-up by the Killer and is being carried, you see the Auras of Hooks and Scourge Hooks.

You can sabotage Hooks. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Save the best for last
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn 1 Token, up to 8.

For each Token, your basic-attack cooldown are 5% shorter.

Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose 2 Tokens.

While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.

name: Second Wind
description:
After you heal 1 Survivor, while not Broken, when you are unhooked, you gain Broken.

After 20s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.

name: Self-Care
description: You can heal yourself, but 65% slower.

name: Unbreakable
description:
Once per trial, while downed by the Killer, you can fully recover.

While downed, you recover 35% faster.

name: Shadowborn
description: Whenever you are blinded, gain 10% Haste for 10s.

name: Slippery Meat
description: You can attempt to unhook yourself up to 6 times and have 4% more chance to succeed.

name: Sloppy Butcher
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:
  • They gain Hemorrhage for 90s.
  • They gain Mangled for 90s.


Survivors with Hemorrhage lose healing progress 25% faster.

name: Small Game
description:
Within 12m of you, whenever you look at a Totem in a 45 degree cone, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: 10s.

Whenever a Survivor cleanses a Totem, you earn 1 Token, up to 5.

For each Token, the cone is 5 degrees smaller.

name: Sole Survivor
description:
Whenever a Survivor dies, you earn 1 Token.

For each Token, within 24m, the Killer cannot see your Aura.

When all other Survivors are dead:
  • You repair 75% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates and the Hatch 50% faster.


When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

name: Solidarity
description: While injured and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, you also gain healing progress at 70% speed.

name: Soul Guard
description:
While hexed, you can fully recover.

Whenever you fully recover, you gain Endurance for 8s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Spies from the Shadows
description: Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within 36m of you, you are alerted. Cooldown: 5s.

name: Spine Chill
description:
Within 36m, whenever the Killer looks at you, you hear a sound cue.

Within 36m, while the Killer is looking at you:
  • You bless and cleanse Totems 6% faster.
  • You heal 6% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates 6% faster.
  • You repair Generators 6% faster.
  • You sabotage Hooks 6% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors 6% faster.
  • You unlock Chests 6% faster.

name: Spirit Fury
description: After you break 2 Pallets, when you are Pallet-stunned, the Pallet is destroyed.

name: Sprint Burst
description:
Whenever you start running:
  • You gain 50% Haste for 2s.
  • You gain Exhausted for 40s.

name: Stake Out
description:
After hiding for 15s within the Killer's Terror Radius, you earn 1 Token, up to 4.

Whenever you hit a good basic Skill Check, spend 1 Token:
  • The good Skill Check becomes a great Skill Check.
  • You gain 1% more progress.

name: Streetwise
description:
The first time you deplete an item's Charges, you see the Killer's Aura for 8s.

Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it has 80% more Charges.

name: Stridor
description: Survivors' breathing noises are 25% louder and their Grunts of Pain are 50% louder.

name: Surge
description:
Whenever you down a Survivor with a basic-attack, Generators within 32m:
  • Explode, lose 8% progress and start regressing.
  • Survivor repairing them scream.

name: Surveillance
description:
You see the Auras of regressing Generators.

Whenever a Generator stops regressing, you see its Aura for 16s.

Generator repair noises can be heard from 8m farther away.

name: Technician
description:
While repairing a Generator:
  • The range of Generator repair noises is 16m shorter.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses 2% more progress.

name: Tenacity
description:
While downed:
  • You gain 50% Haste.
  • You can crawl and recover at the same time.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are 75% quieter.
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.

name: Territorial Imperative
description: Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are 24m away from it, you see their Aura for 6s. Cooldown: 45s.

name: Thanatophobia
description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor, all Survivors:
  • Cleanse totems 2% slower.
  • Repair 2% slower.
  • Sabotage Hooks 2% slower.


While 4 Survivors are either injured, downed or hooked, all above actions are additionally 12% slower.

name: Mettle of Man
description:
After taking 3 protection hits, while injured and until you go down, the next time you would be downed by the Killer, take no damage instead.

When you become healthy, while you are at least 16m from the Killer, they see your Aura.

When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

name: This Is Not Happening
description: While injured, great basic Skill Check zones are 30% bigger.

name: Thrilling Tremors
description: Whenever you pick-up a Survivor, all Generators not being repaired are blocked for 16s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Tinkerer
description:
The first time each Generator has 70% progress:
  • You gain Undetectable for 16s.
  • You are alerted.

name: Trail of Torment
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, until it stops regressing:
  • You gain Undetectable.
  • Survivors see that Generator's Aura.


Cooldown: 30s.

name: Unnerving Presence
description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius get 10% more basic Skill Checks.

The good zone of basic Skill Checks is 60% smaller.

name: Unrelenting
description: Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is 30% shorter.

name: Up the Ante
description:
For each other Survivor alive, all Survivors are 3% luckier.

All Survivors can attempt to unhook themselves.

name: Urban Evasion
description: While crouched, you gain 100% Haste.

name: Vigil
description:
All Survivors within 16m of you:
  • Lose Blindness 40% faster.
  • Lose Broken 40% faster.
  • Lose Exhausted 40% faster.
  • Lose Exposed 40% faster.
  • Lose Hemorrhage 40% faster.
  • Lose Hindered 40% faster.
  • Lose Mangled 40% faster.
  • Lose Oblivious 40% faster.


After they leave your range, this ends after 15s.

name: Visionary
description:
Within 32m of you, you see the Auras of Generators.

Whenever a Generator is completed, cooldown: 16s.

name: Wake Up!
description:
When all Generators are completed:
  • You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
  • While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.
  • For each Survivor alive, you open Exit Gates 12.5% faster.

name: We'll make it
description: Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for 90s, you heal other Survivors 100% faster.

name: We're Gonna Live Forever
description:
You heal downed Survivors 100% faster.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor, they gain Endurance for 10s. Cooldown: 30s.

name: Whispers
description: While within 32m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.

name: Windows of Opportunity
description:
Within 32m of you:
  • You see the Auras of Pallets.
  • You see the Auras of Breakable Walls.
  • You see the Auras of Windows.

name: Zanshin Tactics
description:
Within 32m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows.

Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for 5s.
